name: Raw Material Inspection and Acceptance Procedure
content: Outlines the standardized procedures for receiving, inspecting, and accepting raw materials including pressure testing requirements, dimensional verification, and documentation protocols for valve component acceptance into inventory.
author: James Richardson

name: Measurement Equipment Calibration Certificate Register
content: Registry documenting all pressure gauges, micrometers, and precision testing instruments with their calibration dates, expiration status, and traceability to NIST standards for API Q1 compliance validation.
author: Patricia Monroe

name: Quality Inspector Training and Competency Assessment
content: Defines training requirements, competency validation methods, and skill assessment procedures for quality inspection personnel including API Q1 certification prerequisites and annual refresher requirements.
author: Michael Chen

name: Production Quality Inspection Reports and Non-Conformance Log
content: Compilation of daily quality inspection reports documenting product testing results, identified defects, non-conformances discovered during final inspection, and remediation status of quality issues.
author: Sandra Williams

name: Corrective Action Requests and Management Review Records
content: Complete CAR system documentation including problem statements, root cause analysis findings, implemented corrective actions, effectiveness verification results, and management review meeting minutes from Q1 2026.
author: Robert Martinez
